author: Corridor Crew
description:
Often in movies, there are scenes that try to portray an appeal to nature. Unfortunately, more often than not, they approach that with poor VFX choices, achieving the opposite literally: A disconnection from nature. In this clip, Corridor Crew takes a look at one such scene from Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri (2017). 

Can you recognize this effect from any movie or TV series you've recently watched?
title: How to NOT add CGI NATURE in movies
